status_explanation: ASSESSMENT_INCOMPLETE means one or more local checks did not produce valid PASS evidence. PRE_QUALIFICATION means local checks ran, while company-owned requirements remain unverified.

checks.scope: Synthetic bootstrap apply/rollback tests; not company rollback evidence.
High-confidence patterns only; not proof that proprietary material is absent.
One CPython loopback connect is blocked before socket operation; not OS firewall or child-process monitoring.
Local deterministic fixture tests only; optional React scripts are forced offline. Not an agent comparison, company OpenCode run, or productivity benchmark.

checks.command: python scripts/golden.py check --full on Python, React, and NiceGUI fixtures

network_policy.attempt_monitor_scope: One CPython loopback connect only; not OS firewall or child-process monitoring.

missing_groups.name: Python wheelhouse and dependency locks
missing_groups.required_action: Select target Python ABI/OS/architecture; stage the approved complete wheel closure with hashes, SBOM, and license inventory.

missing_groups.name: React npm lock and offline store
missing_groups.required_action: Confirm company Node range, OS and architecture; choose active Vitest 4.1.12 or candidate Vitest 5.1.1 only after native compatibility and company OSS review. Review the active stackback notice gap or candidate three notice supplements. Complete company-native Windows/Linux fixture qualification, stage per-target npm caches and browser artifacts through the approved process, verify hashes, and complete company OSS clearance. Neither lock nor public npm audit establishes company approval.

missing_groups.name: Playwright browser binaries
missing_groups.required_action: Stage matching, hash-verified, licensed browser binaries per supported Windows/Linux target.

missing_groups.name: MCP Python SDK and transitive dependencies
missing_groups.required_action: Confirm exact Windows/Linux OS, architecture, Python patch/ABI and glibc; independently review candidate licenses and vulnerabilities; import matching hash-locked archives through the approved process; run native offline install and pip check. Repeat MCP discovery/calls with the company OpenCode build. Company approval is not obtained.

missing_groups.name: Company OpenCode and internal model evidence
missing_groups.required_action: Supply the installed internal build/config summary; set OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=1 and OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH=1 on the actual CLI/server process; disable or network-block the separate desktop updater if used; verify the project web tool denies; repeat synthetic skill/MCP calls on the company build; and run an approved internal model trial only after the Windows/Linux egress gate and attempt monitor are active.

missing_groups.name: OS-enforced no-public-egress policy and attempt monitor
missing_groups.required_action: Enforce host/network default-deny egress for OpenCode and children, allow approved intranet destinations only, and return monitored blocked-attempt evidence.

required_company_targets.windows: UNKNOWN: company OS build, architecture, Python/Node versions, and browser version not supplied
required_company_targets.linux: UNKNOWN: company distribution, glibc, architecture, Python/Node versions, and browser version not supplied

unresolved_license_packages.required_action: Company OSS reviewer must decide whether the package's pinned MIT metadata is sufficient without a bundled MIT notice, confirm the embedded V8 BSD notice remains preserved, or require a tested dependency replacement/removal. Do not treat this evidence as company clearance.

local_probe.host_scope: Local macOS test host only; not company runtime.
local_probe.public_catalog: The older local V1 probe logged a models.dev fetch attempt. A separately checksum-verified public OpenCode V2.2.7 probe showed an attempted GET to models.opencode.ai without OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH=1; Seatbelt denied non-loopback networking. With the variable set, no catalog-fetch log event appeared. Logs are not packet capture or endpoint-monitor evidence.
local_probe.repo_v2_config_on_local_v1: INCOMPATIBLE: the local V1 CLI rejected the V2 mcp.servers configuration.
local_probe.temporary_v1_config: A temporary V1-compatible config reached a local synthetic OpenAI-compatible provider and exposed a skill tool. Its scripted skill call did not complete because the hosted sandbox denied spawning rg.

v2_probe_results.official_sdk_mcp: PASS_LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_CALL; SDK discovery and read-only call with pinned 2026-07-28 and auto modes, 20000 ms timeout
v2_probe_results.standard_fixture_mcp: PASS_LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_CALL; auto discovery fell back to legacy 2025-11-25 and completed read-only call
v2_probe_results.provider_and_injection_scope: SCRIPTED_PROVIDER; tool and skill calls observed, but model reasoning and injection resistance NOT_EVALUATED

cross_platform.scope: This assessment reports only the native host OS; macOS results do not qualify Windows or Linux.

synthetic_tests.scope: Synthetic bootstrap apply/rollback tests; not company rollback evidence.

company_actions.action: Enforce default-deny public egress for OpenCode and every child process on managed Windows and Linux pilot hosts; allow only approved intranet/model/package endpoints. OpenCode v2.2.7 attempts the public `models.opencode.ai` catalog by default. Set `OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=1` and `OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH=1` on the actual managed CLI/server process before a session; separately disable or block the desktop updater if used; monitor denied-attempt evidence.
company_actions.evidence_needed: Policy/version, approved host allowlist, a blocked injected connection attempt, the server's effective environment, and monitored zero-public-attempt evidence during the smoke run.

company_actions.action: Provide the exact internal OpenCode build and sanitized config format; keep `webfetch`/`websearch` denied; verify the Golden agent/skill/command adapter and repeat the tested synthetic MCP discovery/call on that build without exposing provider values.
company_actions.evidence_needed: Version/build, config-key summary, company skill and MCP discovery/call traces, effective server environment, permission behavior, and approved internal model identifier.

company_actions.action: Run matched plain-OpenCode versus Golden synthetic tasks after the egress gate; record independent acceptance, elapsed time, rework, latency and trusted runtime token/request events where available.
company_actions.evidence_needed: Reproducible task records. Otherwise retain `BLOCKED_COMPANY_RUNTIME`; no uplift claim.

company_actions.action: Map Golden qualification and signed immutable bundle delivery onto existing company CI and artifact systems.
company_actions.evidence_needed: Existing pipeline/artifact identifiers and rollback/exception owners.

company_actions.action: Run doctor/apply/rollback and no-AI/offline tests on the approved company images.
company_actions.evidence_needed: Sanitized results, per-target versions and asset hashes.

company_actions.action: Review the qualification evidence and explicitly approve or reject a Golden release.
company_actions.evidence_needed: Human release decision; no automatic/model approval.
